answer: Concretely, the economy can anchor each identity to a chain event only an independent operator could cite. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The sparrow of work and the lagoon of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a forge to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
